items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: Landry played that with Big Al Louie.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, Landry. He used to play with. He used to play down at Lutton's. Do you remember the Bern, that place?

You read about that in the paper? No. He played at Lutton's. Landry played that with Big Al Louie. You call it the old folks home, it's down on Almanaster. Oh, they had that place there for years. Billy and the Dee and George Lewis. All those. Used to be like that. Well, I guess you all have been away from New Orleans too long. No, I didn't get back.
But Lord, every place when I was there, I didn't know nothing about who.
